package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations/definition"
)

const (
	definitionFormat = definition.DefinitionFormatVersion
	loaderABI        = definition.LoaderABIVersion
	operationCodec   = definition.OperationCodecVersion
	schemaIR         = definition.SchemaIRVersion

	maxSources                  = definition.MaxSources
	maxSourceIDBytes            = definition.MaxSourceIDBytes
	maxDocumentBytes            = definition.MaxDocumentBytes
	maxBatchBytes               = definition.MaxBatchBytes
	maxJSONDepth                = definition.MaxJSONDepth
	maxDocumentJSONValues       = definition.MaxDocumentJSONValues
	maxJSONValues               = definition.MaxJSONValues
	maxDependenciesPerMigration = definition.MaxDependenciesPerMigration
	maxOperationsPerMigration   = definition.MaxOperationsPerMigration
	maxFieldsPerCreateModel     = definition.MaxFieldsPerCreateModel
)

var (
	_ = definition.EmptySetDigest
	_ = definition.CategorySource

	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeInvalidSource
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeInvalidDocument
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeDefinitionFormatIncompatible
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeLoaderABIIncompatible
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeOperationCodecIncompatible
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeSchemaIRIncompatible
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeUnsupportedOperation
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeInvalidOperation
	_ definition.ErrorCode = definition.CodeInvalidIR

	_ func(...definition.Source) (definition.Set, definition.LoadReport, error)                                                = definition.Load
	_ func(definition.Set, context.Context, migrations.Executor, migrations.LifecycleRequest) (migrations.ProjectState, error) = definition.Set.Migrate
)

func InspectMigrationDefinitions(sources ...definition.Source) (string, []migrations.Migration, []definition.SourceInfo, definition.LoadReport, error) {
	set, report, err := definition.Load(sources...)
	if err != nil {
		if sourceError, ok := err.(*definition.Error); ok {
			context := sourceError.Context()
			_ = context.GraphSources()
		}
		if failure, ok := report.Failure(); ok {
			_ = failure.GraphSources()
		}
		return set.Digest(), set.Definitions(), set.Sources(), report, err
	}
	return set.Digest(), set.Definitions(), set.Sources(), report, nil
}

func PublicMigrationDefinitionValues() (definition.Source, definition.Producer, definition.SourceInfo, definition.GraphSource, definition.FailureContext, definition.LoadReport, definition.Error) {
	key := migrations.MigrationKey{App: "news", Name: "0001_initial"}
	producer := definition.Producer{Name: "example-generator", Version: "1.0.0"}
	return definition.Source{SourceID: "caller-owned", Document: []byte(`{}`)},
		producer,
		definition.SourceInfo{SourceID: "caller-owned", Producer: producer, Migration: key},
		definition.GraphSource{Migration: key, SourceID: "caller-owned"},
		definition.FailureContext{
			Stage: "semantic", SourceID: "caller-owned", JSONPointer: "/migration", App: "news", Name: "0001_initial",
			OperationIndex: -1, Reason: "invalid_operation", Limit: "", Maximum: 0, Actual: 0,
		},
		definition.LoadReport{
			DocumentsReceived: 1, HeadersValidated: 1, OperationsDecoded: 0, PlannerConstruction: 0,
			DefinitionsPublished: 0, DefinitionSetsPublished: 0,
		},
		definition.Error{Category: definition.CategorySource, Code: definition.CodeInvalidOperation}
}
